description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Complete Transmission and Transfer Case Shifter Repair Kit for 90′-95′ model Samurai™s that use the larger 12mm Locating Bolt.
This kit addresses all the common problems that cause the shift levers to bind or drag.
This is the only kit that repairs all aspects of the Transfer Case shifting mechanism.
Repairs both the Transmission and Transfer Case Shift Levers.
Don’t play hit or miss with your shifter problems. Get this kit and fix the problem the first time.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
FOR – TRANSFER CASE
To Repair Shifting Rods / Shafts
Qty 1 – E-Ring
Qty 1 – Spring Pin, Front Drive Fork
Qty 1 – Spring Pin, Reduction Fork
Qty 3 – Ball, Shaft (Reduction & Front Drive)
Qty 1 – Ball, Shaft (Front Drive)
Qty 2 – Spring, Shaft (Reduction & Front Drive)
Qty 1 – Screw, (Spring Cap)
To Repair Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Sheet Shifter
Qty 1 – Spring, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Boot #2, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Clamp, Boot #2
FOR – TRANSMISSION
To Repair Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Cover, Lever Case
Qty 1 – Washer, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Bush, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Boot #2, Shift Lever
Qty 3 – Bolts for Cover
Qty 1 – Locating Bolt / 12mm
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 (Only models using 12mm locating)
Suzuki SJ413 1990 – 1995 (Only models using 12mm locating)
